visual_brief: Guangzhou CTF has a pale, vertically ribbed facade, asymmetric setbacks and a split-height crown. It stands beside K11 and Guangzhou Library; Huacheng Square and Pearl River viewpoints reveal its recognizable profile. Distinguish it from the rounded Guangzhou IFC West Tower, lattice-waisted Canton Tower and smoothly tapered Tianjin CTF.
notes: Six distinct photographs retained; c1 recommended. All passed JPEG decoding, dimension checks and visual inspection. No visible watermarks. Source pages state no reuse licence. References were not reused. Node handled downloads after Python was unavailable and curl failed TLS.
